newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM merges two flame retardants units.
newsitem.headline: DSM merges two flame retardants units.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Thursday it was merging two of its subsidiaries into a new unit called DSM Melapur bv in order to exploit the growth potential of melamine flame retardants.
DSM units DSM Melamine and DSM Chemie Linz will be merged into DSM Melapur which will further develop melanine flame retardants.
The new company, which will start trading on January 1, 1997, will have annualised sales of some 15 million Dutch guilders and be based in Geleen in the Netherlands.
Flame retardants are powders or liquids which are added to all sorts of plastics and textiles to reduce their tendency to burn.
